page.content:
Sports entertainment's global promotion — titles, brands, and decades of character lore.

How WWE connects

  • Character: Vince McMahon — Vince McMahon built WWE from the WWWF.
  • Work: Monday Night Raw — Monday Night Raw is WWE's longest-running weekly flagship.
  • Event: WrestleMania — WrestleMania is WWE's annual showcase event.
  • Work: Friday Night SmackDown — SmackDown is WWE's blue-brand weekly show.
  • Concept: Attitude Era — The Attitude Era is the late-1990s chapter of WWE television.
  • Event: SummerSlam — SummerSlam is WWE's August premium live event.
  • Event: Royal Rumble — The Royal Rumble is WWE's January WrestleMania qualifier.
  • Location: Stamford — WWE's headquarters sit in Stamford, Connecticut.
  • Character: Triple H — Triple H became the executive who books modern WWE.
  • Event: Survivor Series — Survivor Series is WWE's November tradition.
  • Faction: The Bloodline — The Bloodline is the defining WWE faction of the 2020s.
  • Character: The Rock — The Rock became WWE's most exported crossover star.
  • Item: Intercontinental Championship — The Intercontinental Championship is WWE's historic midcard prize.
  • Faction: Judgment Day — Judgment Day is a main-roster WWE stable.
  • Faction: nWo — WWE later imported nWo trademarks and nostalgia chapters after buying WCW.

What is WWE?

WWE is the Stamford-based promotion that grew from the Capitol Wrestling / WWWF lineage into a worldwide television company. Its lore runs through Raw, SmackDown, the PPV calendar, and title lineages from the Attitude Era through The Bloodline.

Key threads lead to Vince McMahon, Monday Night Raw, WrestleMania, Friday Night SmackDown, Attitude Era and SummerSlam.
